newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine group to invest $265 mln in Bolivian gas.
newsitem.headline: Argentine group to invest $265 mln in Bolivian gas.

text.p: Argentine holding Perez Companc announced Thursday the completion of deals to buy Bolivian Empresa Petrolera Andina shares for a total $265 million.
Perez told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange Andina will be operated by Argentine oil company YPF SA.
Perez, YPF and Pluspetrol Energy SA, also from Argentina, form a consortium that owns 50 percent of Andina. Spain's Repsol owns a 45 percent of Pluspetrol through its Argentine affiliate Astra.
A Perez source told Reuters the investment will be channelled mainly to gas reserves development and gas production.
Andina was formed late last year after Bolivia's state oil company was split in three and privatized. Its other half is in the hands of Pension Fund of Bolivia.
